Director, AI Strategy - Meridian Financial Group (fictional fixture)

Denver, CO (hybrid). Reports to the Chief Digital Officer.

About the role

Meridian Financial Group is hiring a Director of AI Strategy to own the
enterprise AI roadmap and lead our GenAI transformation across 8 business
lines. You will define AI governance, build the target operating model, and
align executive stakeholders including the board.

Requirements

- 10+ years in strategy, digital transformation or AI leadership
- Experience building an AI governance framework in a regulated industry
- Proven GenAI adoption at enterprise scale
- Executive stakeholder management and board communication
- Budget ownership and vendor management
- Familiarity with AWS or Azure ML platforms

Preferred

- Financial services background
- Experience with Snowflake and modern data platforms
- MBA or equivalent experience

What you will do

- Own the enterprise AI strategy and multi-year roadmap
- Stand up AI governance and responsible-AI review
- Move GenAI use cases from pilot to production
- Partner with risk, legal and compliance on AI policy
